finite_lessons: Real game-scope endpoint isolation needs exact own instance/image, no existing stream, repeated kernel policy readback and independent dynamic cleanup; no injected game HTTP needed or claimed.
An ordinary trade agreement, immediate cached treasury yield, accepted war, settled deal disappearance and actual wallet delta are distinct evidence stages.
Every actual budget input/result can be checked against current real pure Lua and frozen math; a score callback or number of passes is not a Native request count.
Sampled per-city income, treasury aggregate and previous-round wallet prediction can differ; unexplained internal timing stays explicit and is not attributed to generated model gains.
Actual fresh qualified actor IDs and observed unit types correct a missing-name exclusion classifier without replaying game operations.
